meaning:
δια-σαφέω, -ῶ
(σαφής, clear), [in LXX: Deu.1:5 (בָּאַר pi.), Dan LXX 2:6 (חָוָה aphel.), I-III Ma 9 * ;]
to make clear, explain fully: with accusative of thing(s), dative of person(s), Mat.13:26 18:31.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”
